{"script":"# 1. Access permissions snapshot
ls -ld /var > temp_var_workspace/var_access_snapshot.txt

# 2. Recursive listing
find /var -ls > temp_var_workspace/var_listing.txt

# 3. Files only (regular files start with '-' in the ls -l output)
# find -ls output format: inode blocks perms links owner group size date name
# Regular files have perms starting with '-'
grep "^ *[0-9]* *[0-9]* *-" temp_var_workspace/var_listing.txt > temp_var_workspace/var_files_only.txt
wc -l < temp_var_workspace/var_files_only.txt > temp_var_workspace/var_files_intermediate_count.txt

# 4. Consolidate
cat temp_var_workspace/var_files_only.txt temp_var_workspace/var_files_intermediate_count.txt temp_var_workspace/var_access_snapshot.txt > temp_var_workspace/var_count_metadata.txt

# Verify and get the count
cat temp_var_workspace/var_files_intermediate_count.txt
"}
